answer: Resist sybils with a verifiable work-history chain: an identity earns weight only by completing real tasks for distinct, established counterparties, each recorded as a signed receipt. An honest agent climbs to the summit of trust one job at a time, its record reading like a sonnet of real work. Clones arrive with empty histories, and faking a thousand receipts means paying a thousand task fees to distinct counterparties, so each fake identity costs genuine commerce, not copy-paste. The harbor admits only ships that have actually sailed.
